release_notes: Build 97 hardens duplicate Quiz History path repair so contradictory episode evidence can never be approved automatically.

When a legacy project folder uses a trusted trailing sequence such as 'Logos - 001', a History row for episode #003 is now rejected as No match immediately instead of merely receiving a score penalty.
A matching trailing sequence still strengthens valid repairs, such as 'History Quiz - 001' for episode #001.

Folders with an explicit #episode marker keep that marker authoritative: for example 'Film Quiz #002 - Short - 001' is treated as episode #002 and the trailing export sequence is not misread as the episode.
The final apply step repeats the same episode-safety evaluation before any database path is changed, so a stale preview cannot bypass the rule.
Duplicate-path repair remains database-only and does not move, copy, rename, overwrite or delete C: or Z: files.
The faster Archive completed C report, live C: to Z: progress display, archive verification and no-overwrite protections remain in place.
Regression tests cover the Logos #003 rejection, a valid matching trailing sequence, and explicit #episode precedence.
